title: A pre-authorized-transaction signer removed by a failed transaction produces no signer_removed

target.versions_affected: e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967 (range not established); also 3e22515a (checked 2026-11-13); also 18db88f4 (replay 2026-11-19); also f0c00cf5 (replay 2026-11-20)

severity_basis: A failed transaction whose pre-authorized-transaction signer stellar-core removed (CAP-28) produces no signer_removed state change, so wallet-backend keeps reporting a signer the account no longer has. Executed through the replay harness on four local stellar-core ledgers (Protocols 28 and 30, testnet and pubnet passphrases), on both inputs; the baseline indexer reports the change.

entries.expected: a signer_removed state change for the pre-auth-tx signer stellar-core removed
entries.observed: Executed at e967ce8b through the replay harness, both inputs: dropped · partial, no signer_removed for GAC75KAX… in the failed transaction (9d62dbee… on the pubnet variants, c1cbc388… on the testnet variants); every other compared fact matched.

evidence.pre_fix: make replay-full (the whole corpus against wallet-backend at the pinned current commit e967ce8b, both inputs): dropped · partial on all four variants. Still reproduces at 3e22515a.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-28 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/f2d364902615af726b3533021403c8b225aa6e5d/core/cap-0028.md): from Protocol 13 stellar-core removes a pre-authorized-transaction signer when the transaction is applied, whatever its result; the ledger meta of the failed transaction shows the signer removed from the account entry.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone: 4 of 4 listed report rows failed again as recorded, offline. Reproduced again at 3e22515a on both inputs before filing.

approval.scope: Public issue on stellar/wallet-backend (#805): a CAP-28 pre-auth signer removed by a failed transaction gets no SIGNER/REMOVE, only the fee debit.

history.note: Created from the replay run's failure rows; no public upstream item found.
Reproduced, upstream searched (none found), issue text written; awaiting a maintainer's review before filing.

Filed by the maintainers of this kit as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/805 at main 3e22515a (also e967ce8b), transaction c1cbc388…, with the LedgerCloseMeta and a ProcessLedger test in the issue.
Executed again at the pinned current commit 18db88f4 (make replay-full, both inputs): the same rows as at 3e22515a; the entries' divergences name 18db88f4.

Executed again at the pinned current commit f0c00cf5 (make replay-full, both inputs): the same rows as at 18db88f4; the entries' divergences name f0c00cf5. The commits between them change only the GraphQL server's metrics (internal/serve, internal/metrics), not ingest.
